decision.explanation: The question asks what conflict the Battle of Beirut is associated with. Three distinct historical events named 'Battle of Beirut' are described in the provided sources: (1) the 1912 naval engagement during the Italo-Turkish War (D1S1), (2) the 1941 battle marking the end of the Syria-Lebanon campaign in World War II (D2S1), and (3) the 1982 Siege of Beirut as part of the 1982 Lebanon War (D5S4/D5S5). Each refers to a separate conflict and is supported directly by the source texts. There is no contradiction among these because they pertain to distinct battles with different dates and contexts.
